shots.keyframe: A softly glowing spiral seashell half-buried in wet black volcanic rock at the tide line at dawn, shallow seawater and white foam washing around it, drifting mist, golden-pink light. Premium 3D dimensional Pixar soft-fur style, NOT painterly, NOT flat.
shots.motion: Gentle waves and white foam wash in and recede around the glowing shell, mist drifts across frame, water ripples and reflects the dawn light. Slow smooth push-in. Locked stable camera, no jitter, no shake.

shots.keyframe: CLOSE-UP of Bentley the red-fawn Boxer puppy — head and upper chest fill the frame, paws and legs OUT of frame. Alert and eagerly curious, head turned toward a sound, bright intelligent eyes wide, eager to investigate. Natural dog mouth with soft pink tongue and small dog teeth — NO human teeth, NO human grin. On-model: black mask, grey chin, soulful well-proportioned eyes (NOT googly), BOTH ears soft floppy folded DOWN, red-fawn coat, small white blaze on chest, teal collar with glowing spiral seashell charm. Premium 3D dimensional Pixar soft-fur style, NOT painterly.
shots.line: [curious] A voice? Somebody needs help — come on!

shots.motion: Bentley pads forward across the wet rocks, nose down, ears swivelling, tracking; the tide-pool water ripples and reflects the dawn, foam shifts. Smooth tracking camera, locked and stable, no jitter, no shake.
